reconcile.note: Jamieson, Fausset & Brown, following Fairbairn, read Hosea's Egypt as naming a bondage condition Assyria would replicate, not the literal country revisited.

sides.verseText: As for the sacrifices of my offerings, they sacrifice flesh and eat it; But Yahweh doesn't accept them. Now he will remember their iniquity, And punish their sins. They will return to Egypt.

sides.snippet: They won't return into the land of Egypt
sides.verseText: \"They won't return into the land of Egypt; But the Assyrian will be their king, Because they refused to repent.
